title: Item:Horrid Golden Figurine
wikitext:
[[Image:QuestItem HorridGoldenFigurine.png]]

The Horrid Golden Figurine can be found in [[Slavers of the Shrieking Mines]] after the bottommost Mindflayer Overlord is defeated; go to the area behind the chest for a collectable location. The Horrid Golden Figurine is used in the underground passages in the Restless Isles to skip a group of tough Ogres on the way to [[The Restless Isles#Volcano's Mouth|Volcano's Mouth]], the location of [[The Twilight Forge]].

The Horrid Golden Figurine is required for [[The Restless Isles]] Explorer: Explore the wildman alcove, and, by extension, to reach the spawn point for [[Kaedak]]. As you cannot tell from outside if Kaedak has spawned, you may need to farm multiple figurines.
